pillar_rules.hidden: Explain a hidden piece of everyday technology with simple, factual narration.
pillar_rules.explainer: Explain how a technology works using a wrong assumption as the hook, then reveal the real mechanism.
pillar_rules.fun_fact: Deliver a surprising true technology fact with a simple explanation.
pillar_rules.gaming: Explain a real technology concept behind gaming hardware or software.
pillar_rules.tip: Teach one useful, verified technology setting or trick.
pillar_rules.finds: Explain a useful gadget or app with verified facts.
pillar_rules.comparison: Compare two products or technologies using verified facts.
pillar_rules.news: Explain one fresh, verified technology story.

voices.style_note: Educational, authoritative male narrator. Calm, confident, mature, and natural, like a knowledgeable teacher explaining something clearly to a class. Conversational rather than announcer-like. Strong articulation, measured pacing, subtle warmth, no exaggerated excitement, no robotic delivery, no generic AI-assistant tone. Do not imitate or clone any real person.

voice_note: One consistent educational, authoritative male narrator voice. Natural teacher delivery, calm confidence, clear articulation, and human conversational rhythm. NIGHTFILES_VOICE can override the configured Kokoro voice.
